ثَاوٍ part. n. of 1; (Msb;) [Remaining, &c.: or remaining, &c., long:] a stranger remaining, staying, dwelling, or abiding, in a country, or town: (T:) or ثَاوِى بَلْدَةٍ a stranger who keeps to a country, or town. (M.) ―
-b2- A man remaining in his grave. (IB, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
